wiki.title: Ray Sorensen (politician)
wiki.extract: Ray "Bubba" Sorensen II (born 1979) is an American artist, businessman, and politician serving as a member of the Iowa House of Representatives from the 23rd district. Elected in November 2018, he assumed office on January 14, 2019.
